items.source: Sets the content type of the view to "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet".
items.translation: 将视图的内容类型设置为 `"application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet"`。

items.source: Deprecated, for removal: This API element is subject to removal in a future version.
items.translation: 已弃用，即将移除：此 API 元素将在未来版本中移除。

items.source: This implementation creates an XSSFWorkbook for the XLSX format.
items.translation: 此实现为 XLSX 格式创建了一个XSSFWorkbook。

items.source: For working with the workbook in subclasses, see Apache's POI site.
items.translation: 要在子类中操作工作簿，请参阅 Apache 的 POI 网站。

items.source: since 7.0. Libraries or applications can provide their own View class or perform rendering in web handlers directly.
items.translation: 自 7.0 版本起，库或应用程序可以提供自己的 `View` 类，或在 Web 处理器中直接执行渲染。

items.source: request - current HTTP request (for taking the URL or headers into account)
items.translation: request - 当前 HTTP 请求（用于考虑 URL 或标头）
